subject: Recap & MPA: BlueCrest discovery — next steps and decision gates
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & MPA: BlueCrest discovery — next steps and decision gates

Claire — thanks again for a focused call this morning. Quick written recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we all have the same runway. Attaching a draft MAP and a short security summary for your SOC/infosec team.

High-level problem we heard
- Inference cost and latency variability across peak hours is blocking production rollout for your customer-facing summarization product.
- Current on-prem infra gives predictable latency but lacks autoscaling and observability for token-level cost.

Goals we aligned on
- Stable 100–200ms p95 latency for 2k concurrent sessions during peak windows.
- 40% net reduction in per-token cost through batching and KV cache for prompt templates.
- Pilot with 3 customer personas for 6 weeks to validate quality and rollback behavior.

Proposed milestones (dates are provisional)
1) Security & compliance review kickoff — owner: Rajesh Kumar (BlueCrest) — target: 2026-12-07
2) Pilot scope & test dataset agreed — owners: Claire + Hannah — target: 2026-12-14
3) Commercial/Procurement draft SOW and pricing — owners: BlueCrest procurement + Ben — target: 2026-12-21
4) Executive signoff (CTO or Head of Product) — owner: Claire — target: 2026-12-23
5) Pilot deploy (private VPC) — owner: Redwood infra ops — target: 2027-01-04

Decision process / approval gates
- Security signoff required before provisioning private capacity.
- Procurement needs the MAP + pilot acceptance criteria to move to a 60-day reserved capacity quote.
- Executive signoff is binary (go / no-go) after the scope and SOW are agreed.

Who’s looped and immediate asks
- Please confirm Rajesh (infosec) and your procurement contact so we can route documents.
- Claire: are the milestone dates feasible for your internal calendar?
- Rajesh: I included a short security-sheet in attachments for your team to scan; happy to schedule a working session.

Attachments (stubs):
- BlueCrest-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)
- security-questionnaire-summary.pdf (high-level answers, next evidence needed)
- pilot-scope-onepager.pdf (scope, success metrics, sample dataset requirements)

Next step: if those milestones look right I’ll publish MAP v1 to the Drive and open a HubSpot task for each milestone. Also propose a 45-minute security workshop on 2026-12-02 — ping back availability.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference

From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@bluecrest.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@bluecrest.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & MPA: BlueCrest discovery — next steps and decision gates

Thanks Hannah — this is great and captures the call well. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Rajesh will own the security review and can attend the 12/02 workshop. He flagged that our engineering security board meets every Tuesday, so anything for evidence should be delivered by 12/01 to hit the 12/07 target.
- Procurement contact: meghan.torres@bluecrest.ai (cc-ing her on a separate thread tomorrow).
- Executive signoff: I will bring the MAP to our weekly exec sync on 12/20 and aim to lock decision that week (so the 12/23 target is reasonable).

One addition to the MAP: we require a minimal SLA for failure modes during the pilot (automated fallback to smaller models + documented rollback playbook). Can you add that as an acceptance criterion?

I confirmed internal timelines — 12/14 for scope + datasets works for the team. Please route the updated MAP to Rajesh and Meghan when ready.

Claire Johnson
Head of ML Products, BlueCrest AI
claire.johnson@bluecrest.ai | +1 617-555-0421

Adding a few internal notes so we’re aligned before we push the MAP to their team:
- Action: I’ll draft a pilot pricing sheet that supports both a usage band and a 60-day reserved capacity option — aim to share by 12/16 so procurement has time to review.
- Action: Monica, can you prepare the one-pager on rollback + failure modes (include the fallback-to-smaller-model flow and estimated cost delta)? Claire asked for SLA language as acceptance criteria.
- Ops note: private VPC provisioning lead time is ~10 business days once security signoff is complete; keep that in the schedule.

I’ll also flag possible discount thresholds tied to committed throughput in the draft SOW.

Ben
